title: Kolami - Wikipedia
text: Kolami (IPA: [kolaːmi], Northwestern Kolami/Southeastern Kolami) is a tribal Central Dravidian language spoken in Maharashtra and Telangana states of India. It falls under the Kolami-Naiki group of languages. It is the most widely spoken Central Dravidian language.

title: Naiki language - Wikipedia
text: Naiki (IPA: [naːjki]), or Southeastern Kolami, is a tribal Central Dravidian language used in Maharashtra state of India. Dialects are Naiki proper, or Chanda, and Naikṛi (Krishnamurti 2003:57)
